title: ARCS Verify amnesiac-chain report (arcs_verify.report.v0_1_1)
description: Descriptive schema for the amnesiac-chain subcommand's JSON report. Non-normative: the verifier code is the source of truth. Consumers must tolerate additional properties.

boundary_note.description: States that structural integrity only is established and what an authenticity claim would additionally require.

conclusions.description: Conclusion values are in the domain true / false / not_evaluated, serialized as strings. authenticity_verified and signature_verified are reserved and always not_evaluated.

findings.description: Empty on a clean run; otherwise names the artifact and property that failed to recompute.

passed.description: Computed from the gating conclusions only; reserved conclusions never contribute.

verified_artifacts.description: Identifiers and recomputed hashes of the artifact set this run verified.
